verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a dedicated GitHub Actions CI/CD guide for testing agents automatically on every code change, pull request, or custom schedule. It also documents scheduled cron jobs, a terminal CLI for managing agents, scenarios and runs, sync and async SDKs, project-level API keys, and an OpenAPI spec, all of which together support headless automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs, and details on CI exit codes or pass/fail gating.
